title: The finite basis problem for additively idempotent semirings of order four, IV
summary: This paper is the fourth in a series devoted to the finite basis problem for $4$-element additively idempotent semirings. These algebras are divided into five types according to their additive reducts; we study the largest of these types, namely those whose additive reducts are chains. Up to isomorphism, there are $386$ such algebras, denoted by $S_{(4, k)}$, $481 \leq k \leq 866$. We show that all but three of them, namely $S_{(4,545)}$, $S_{(4,634)}$, and $S_{(4,710)}$, are finitely based.
